column1: # p423, 2026-10-24 — ACTION p421-A DISCHARGED: compose/code/* enumerated against HOOK_GATES.
# p421 asked for 'one listing against one variable' and expected 'a large, mostly-legitimate
# difference'.  It is large.  The legitimate part is real: most of these directories are
# single-pass instruments that answered one question and were never meant to stand.
# 🔴 The part that is NOT legitimate is the last row: 15 directories carry a suite nothing
# runs AND describe themselves as a gate.  `gate-region-headings` (p338) and
# `action-gap-crosscheck` (p421) were instances 1 and 2 of exactly that shape; this is a
# measured candidate POPULATION where p421 had no number at all.
# 🟡 'Self-describes as a gate' is a TEXT match, deliberately crude and stated as such: it
# names candidates, not defects.  Each of the 15 needs its own adjudication, which is what
# ACTION p423-A asks for.  This pass claims the denominator, not the verdicts.
# 🔵 Channel: directory name matched as a substring anywhere in the Makefile, so a target
# invoking `compose/code/<dir>/x.py` counts as named.  HOOK_GATES read with p423's own
# parser (commit_gate.read_sets), not a fresh regex — a fresh one over-read to 137 by
# swallowing the DECLARED_RED block, and the instrument was right.
